title: Ethiopian-Style Vegetable Korma
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired korma dish made with a combination of vegetables in a creamy sauce, served over a bed of basmati rice.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cubed cheese and cook until it is lightly browned.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the korma sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
Serve the korma sauce over the cooked noodles.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
